parameters.jsCode: const input = {"reference_date":"2030-01-15","next_due":"2030-01-17","opted_in":true,"reminder_hour":"11:00","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","duplicate_found":false,"correlation_id":"DEMO-GOLD-2"}; const correlation_id = input.correlation_id || 'DEMO-SCHEME-REMINDER'; return [{json:{...input, correlation_id, _demo:true, _scenario:'scheme-reminder'}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const fail=(reason)=>({status:'NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW',review_required:true,reason,correlation_id:d.correlation_id,action_draft:null});const dateOnly=x=>typeof x==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(x); const valid=dateOnly(d.next_due)&&dateOnly(d.reference_date); const due=valid?Date.parse(d.next_due+'T00:00:00Z'):NaN, ref=valid?Date.parse(d.reference_date+'T00:00:00Z'):NaN; const days=(due-ref)/86400000; const opted=d.opted_in===true||String(d.opted_in).toLowerCase()==='yes'; const ok=valid&&Number.isFinite(days)&&opted&&days===2&&d.reminder_hour==='11:00'&&d.timezone==='Asia/Kolkata'&&d.duplicate_found!==true; return [{json:{...d,status:ok?'DRAFT_ONLY':'NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW',review_required:!ok,reason:ok?'Opt-in, exact two-calendar-day window, timezone, and duplicate checks passed':'Reminder requires opted_in yes, exact date-only 2 days, 11:00 Asia/Kolkata, no duplicate',action_draft:ok?{reminder:'DRAFT_ONLY',due:d.next_due}:null}}];
